answers.how: Fit the measured Callisto positions to a circular orbit using the supplied camera distances. The inferred angular speed is about 0.147 rad/s, giving orbital diameter 2 × 0.627 / 0.147 ≈ 8.51 m.
Callisto measures approximately 12.4 pixels across initially. Scaling its measured motion by the known speed and correcting for camera depth gives approximately 0.0110 m per pixel.
The central model measures approximately 126 pixels across. Applying the motion-derived scale and correcting to its 16.549 m camera distance gives a diameter of approximately 1.75 m.
